name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
description: Google's software-engineering-focused Flash model, with a 1M-token context window and a generous free tier via AI Studio. Strongest free starting point for coding and agent work.

name: Poolside Laguna M.1
description: Poolside's flagship agentic-coding model with 262K context, built for complex software-engineering tasks with tool calling, on OpenRouter's free variant.

name: Qwen3 Coder
description: A large-context coding-specialist model, well suited to function/tool calling and long codebases on the free endpoint.

name: Cohere North Mini Code
description: Cohere's agentic coding model with 256K context, trained to generalize across agent harnesses like OpenCode and SWE-Agent.

name: GPT-OSS 120B
description: OpenAI's open-weight reasoning model served at speed by Groq's free plan. Strong on code benchmarks; subject to per-org rate limits.

name: Qwen 3.6 27B
description: A capable open code-and-reasoning model, the current Qwen serving on Groq's free plan (replaced 3.8 in September 2026).

name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super 120B
description: A 1M-context open reasoning model from NVIDIA for architecture, analysis, and structured-output agent tasks on a free endpoint.

name: GPT-OSS 120B (OpenRouter)
description: OpenAI's open-weight 120B model served via OpenRouter's free routing, useful as a Groq fallback when Groq's per-org limits are hit.

name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
description: The only Pro-class Gemini model on the free tier (≈50 req/day). Stronger reasoning than Flash; keep Flash for high-volume iterations.

name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
description: Google's versatile free-tier model with 1M context. Reliable fallback for building and explaining code when 3.8 Flash hits quota.

name: GPT-OSS 20B
description: A smaller, fast open-weight reasoning model for focused coding tasks on Groq's free plan.

name: Poolside Laguna XS.2
description: A lighter Poolside coding agent for responsive, lower-latency edits on OpenRouter's free variant.

name: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
description: Google's lightweight free-tier option for quick questions, extraction, and fast iterations.
